usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing ACME DNS plugin configuration — swap the backing DNS provider API, rotate credentials in the base64-encoded `data` field, or adjust the `validation-delay` if DNS TTLs are causing certificate issuance failures. Requires `Sys.Modify` at the root path; the plugin must already exist (use post_cluster_acme_plugins to create). Pass `digest` (retrieved from get_cluster_acme_plugins_id) to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Update a Cloudflare DNS plugin to increase validation delay and rotate API credentials

tips: The `data` field must be base64-encoded key=value pairs matching the chosen DNS provider's required environment variables (e.g., CF_Token=xxx for Cloudflare).
Set `validation-delay` higher (e.g. 120-300s) when the DNS provider has slow propagation; the default 30s is often too short for providers with long TTLs.
Use the `delete` param to remove individual settings (e.g. `nodes`) rather than resending the full config — avoids accidentally clearing fields.
Use `disable: true` to temporarily take a plugin out of rotation without deleting it, useful when rotating credentials.
Returns null on success; any error indicates the update was not applied.
